name: DaYan GuHong Pro+ 3x3 (Magnetic, Core Magnets) - 55mm
description: The DaYan GuHong Pro+ 3x3 (Magnetic, Core Magnets) – 55mm is a competition-ready 3x3 speed cube that balances fast, accurate turning with excellent stability. Piece magnets help layers “click” into place, while corner-to-core magnets (core magnets) improve alignment control so solves feel smooth and predictable for both new solvers and seasoned competitors.
features: Faster, more accurate turning from 64 total magnets (piece + core).
Core magnets add stability and tracking during high-TPS turns.
Big corner-cutting keeps solves flowing even with imperfect alignment.
Beginner-friendly setup with performance headroom for advanced cubers.
Numerical dual adjustment: 6 tension × 8 compression settings for precise, repeatable tuning.
Adjustable core magnets: 5 strength levels to fine-tune magnetic snap and overall stability.
